result.title: Efficient Latent Reasoning for Vision-Language Model via Dynamics-Aware Quantization and Distillation
result.summary: Efficient chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs) requires reducing both intermediate reasoning steps and their execution cost. Latent CoT methods compress textual rationales into continuous thoughts, yet their full-precision (FP) models retain substantial storage and computation costs. Lowering numerical precision could reduce these remaining costs, yet direct quantization severely degrades reasoning accuracy, particularly with 4-bit weights and activations. Operator and perturbation analyses reveal key sensitivity and direction-dependent predictive effects of continuous-thought errors, motivating preservation of information retrieval and subsequent reasoning beyond reconstruction accuracy. We therefore introduce QL-VLM, a dynamics-aware Quantization framework for efficient Latent reasoning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs). First, Dynamics-Guided Quantization (DGQ) uses nonuniform codebooks that preserve rotary-key structure, mitigating quantization-induced distortion in vision-language information retrieval. Second, Dynamics-Preserving Distillation (DPD) aligns continuous thoughts, latent-query readouts, and predictions with a full-precision teacher, maintaining predictive consistency through subsequent low-precision reasoning. On ScienceQA-IMG with Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct, 4-bit QL-VLM achieves 90.43% accuracy and improves baseline by 40.33%, with 16.64x fewer bit-operations and 6.40x lower measured latency than explicit CoT.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 VLM 中 latent CoT 的低精度部署：分析连续思考对量化误差的敏感性与方向依赖效应，提出 QL-VLM，用保持 rotary-key 结构的非均匀码本量化与对齐连续思考、latent 读出及预测的蒸馏，在 ScienceQA-IMG 上以 4-bit 报告 90.43% 准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及连续思考状态在承载视觉检索信息时的保真与训练监督，可供核查量化扰动如何影响 latent 内容使用、信息坍缩与后续推理一致性，以及蒸馏与量化各自贡献。
